name: Allison Williams
source:
Maternal grandmother of the Main Character. While not the protagonist of the story, Allison is the titular grandmother in whose house much of the story takes place.

Allison is the loving and caring matriarch of her family (which soon becomes an extended family as several non-blood related people move in). She adores her grandson whom she took in after his family perished in a plane crash.

She strongly dislikes swearing and often admonishes MC and other family members on their language use (Amy, especially, is fond of using "fuck"). Her own favourite exclamation is "Goodness!"

Her husband, MC's grandfather, died some years before MC's family died. (MC mentions that she was lonely for several years before he moved in.) He was apparently a shrewd businessman and investor and Allison lives very comfortably on the interests. She also maintains several rental buildings, some as far away as New York. (It is never specified where in the US their small town is located but MC was surprised that Allison's car had NY-plates and she explains that she registered it to one of her properties in NY to get lower insurance.)

Mother of Anne (dead), Amelia and Elizabeth.

Ophelia and, occasionally, Jamila calls her Alice.

Note: Williams is the default surname but the player has the option to change this. The Player may also change the default nickname "Nana" to something else.
